brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Hex base piece carries a Keyhole hanger (hex-acc-keyhole) on face slot 0; mesh check clear. Confirm which face is wall-side when mounting.
Three Hook plates (hex-acc-hook, two hooks each, six total) on face slots 2, 3, 4. Mesh check clear. Hook fit for specific tools not verified; no tool props can sit on accessories.

requirements.requirement: Load and material suitability for a real rack
requirements.evidence: Configurator does not judge load or material. BOM: 16 M6 nuts and 16 M6x20 screws, hand-tightened to 2 N.m on printed PETG; strength not verified.

finish.summary: Built one Hex base with a keyhole hanger on face slot 0 and three hook plates (six hooks) on face slots 2, 3 and 4. Mesh check is clear and check_build shows no errors. Wall orientation and hook fit for particular tools are not verified.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
